tldr: Speaker 1 and Harry synced on weekend on-call cover around tomorrow's (Thu 5 Nov) release, which fixes the carrier label provider issue rather than Snap itself.
The label provider gave the wrong format/spec to Snap's developers; this only surfaced at go-live, causing the Snap back-and-forth this week.
Weekend is the big Purdy and Fig weekend, so on-call is staffed as a fallback; no problems are expected.
Harry is sending an on-call/escalation doc, with references and the standard escalation path, so Speaker 1 can distribute it by about 2pm tomorrow.
Cover: Speaker 1's side has Milo and Joe on site (one each Sat/Sun) and Danny Williams on call as level one; Harry's side has fuse on-call developers at level three and Harry at level four.
decisions: Both sides will treat urgency as equal: questions will be raised promptly and nobody will throw issues over the wall.
On-call tiers: Speaker 1's team covers level one (label printers, shipment issues); Fuse on-call developers level three; Harry level four as backstop.
Harry's side will provide a list of phone numbers and who is on call when.
